notes.title: 🌀 Chapter 1: Reality Break – Update Now Live!
notes.content:
[p]The biggest update to [b]Abyssal Trench[/b] 1st chapter so far is here — expanding the story, adding new mechanics, and turning up the horror.[/p][p]🧠 [b]2 New Endings[/b] – Uncover the truth behind the simulation and unlock the mind-bending final sequence.
🤖 [b]New Mech Sequence[/b] – A free-flying, gravity-shifting area that breaks the boundaries of the old world.
🧩 [b]Memory Shards[/b] – A new collectible system tied to the hidden ending.
🦈 [b]New Jump Scares[/b] – Fresh terror in new locations, just when you think you're safe.
🎧 [b]Voice Lines & Audio Enhancements[/b] – Calm, dreamlike narration replaces the chaos at the end.
👁️ [b]Visual Improvements[/b] – Better lighting, fog tuning, and new surreal environments.[/p][p]This is the definitive version of Chapter 1 — and it’s available now.[/p]

notes.title: Abyssal Trench – Major Update Incoming
notes.content:
Hey divers,
A major update for Abyssal Trench is almost here.

This new version brings some serious changes and additions to the experience:

🧠 2 new endings that reveal deeper layers of the story
⚙️ New mechanics to enhance exploration and tension
⏱️ Almost double the playtime
🌌 A disturbing shift in reality that changes everything…

Whether you’ve reached the end or are just diving in, this update will take the experience even deeper into the unknown.

Thanks for the support — I can’t wait to let you explore what’s coming.
